description: Opt-in automerge layer. Add it only to repositories that run the verify gate. Renovate merges a branch once its status is green, and a repository with no checks has nothing to fail - there the same setting would merge blind. Extend it after the ecosystem preset so these rules win, and note that the closing rules below deliberately re-assert every exclusion the ecosystem preset makes.

packageRules.description: Dev dependencies carry no runtime risk and the gate installs and builds them.

Runtime dependencies: patch and minor. A minor can change behaviour that install and build never exercise, which is the accepted risk here - the alternative was a standing queue of green security fixes waiting on a human. Majors and the tool list below are still excluded.
GitHub Actions are pinned to a digest by config:recommended, so the diff is a hash and the workflow itself is the test.
Never automerge a major, whatever the ecosystem preset said.
Tools that are themselves configuration stay manual. Repeated here because this preset is applied last and would otherwise override the same exclusion in the ecosystem layer.
Gradle wrapper rewrites gradlew and the wrapper jar, so it stays manual here too.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: No automerge key here on purpose. This object is an overlay that Renovate applies after the packageRules above, and an automerge set here wins over all of them - including the major and the tool exclusions, which a dry run confirmed by offering to automerge an Astro vulnerability fix. Leaving the key out lets a vulnerability fix fall through to the same rules as any other update, so a patch merges on a green gate while a major or a tool stays manual.
